metadata.description: Scratched vinyl must route to click/crackle repair before broad denoise.
Vinyl hiss and HF loss must route to spectral/EQ/HF restoration without false crackle strategy.
Worn vinyl must combine surface repair with gentle HF-noise treatment.
Reel tape dropout and HF remanence loss require spectral repair plus transport-aware stabilization.
Cassette wow/flutter must activate speed stabilization and tape-noise/HF-loss repair.
Low-bitrate MP3 must route to codec spectral repair and conservative dynamics recovery.
Streaming glitches must combine spectral repair, dropout repair, and codec artifact cleanup.
Vocal choir hiss must route to gentle tonal/noise repair without crackle or studio vocal enhancement.
